name: Puri-Puri
source:
Taida is a rather lazy 18 year old boy, he spends all day playing video games and watching anime. His mother, tired of this, decided to look for a job for him and, luckily for her (though not for him), finds one: a friend needs to take care of her 16-year-old son named Puri Puri. Taida reluctantly accepts on the condition that he'll only babysit Puri for 2 weeks.
Will he be able to babysit Puri Puri? Will the two of them be able to start a relationship? Will Taida's mother stop saying he's lazy? The answer to these questions is up to you!
translation:
泰达是一个相当懒惰的18岁男孩，他整天玩电子游戏和看动漫。他的母亲对此感到厌倦，决定为他找一份工作，幸运的是她（尽管不是他）找到了一份工作：一位朋友需要照顾她16岁的儿子普里普里。泰达不情愿地接受了，但条件是他只能照顾普里两周。
他能照顾普里普里吗？两人能否开始一段感情呢？泰达的妈妈会不再说他懒吗？这些问题的答案取决于你！
